title: symphyotrichum praealtum
intro: Symphyotrichum praealtum, commonly known as tall blue sage or eastern blue aster, is a perennial plant native to North America. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include treating fever, sore throats, and respiratory issues, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include being used as an antiseptic, expectorant, and demulcent, which can help soothe and calm irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of Symphyotrichum praealtum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
